note: PowerPyx rates this Platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough: the story takes 60–80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100 hours, and cleanup about 10 hours (PowerPyx). Push Square estimates 250 hours or more (Push Square).

stages.g: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start AND the end of every chapter — 15 manual slots plus the autosave (PowerPyx). Never turn cheats on: they disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx). Start two habits in the first hour: scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study new animals through the binoculars (PowerPyx).

After Down to Earth, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and meditate before the chapter ends; it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and the moment disappears (PowerPyx).
stages.n: Chapter 1 — Paradise, and the one missable

stages.g: Both heroes become playable and the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) switch on (Output Lag). Daily Driver unlocks the garage market and Moses opens the Scooter Bros app (Output Lag). Coffee Break unlocks the final meditation spot, which needs both characters (PowerPyx).
The Race Against Yago strand is time-sensitive — run it the moment it shows (Output Lag). Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun, the key to Sneakthief (Output Lag).
Near the end of the chapter, clear That's Where The Money Is to unlock the bank vaults (Output Lag). From here the money trophies open up: vaults, laundering and the armored trucks.

Close out the strands — Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason-only), plus Bret's hunt (Jason-only) (PowerPyx). None of the finales expire; they stay available after the credits (Output Lag).

Finish the story first (manual save before the final mission), then sweep the open world: drone races, card sets, the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero tanks, gang operations (Output Lag). The 100% checklist is now visible under Progress > Stats (Output Lag).

What is left is arithmetic: 250 stunts for the trophy, 300 for the checklist; 42 range golds; 70 of 80 Challenges with the hardest ten skippable (PowerPyx). When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
